title: PERSPECTIVES, SCREENS, AND THE CRYSTAL BALL. First-person / third-person as sub-axes. Triads of triads. Anti-poles. The round pie screen at null center. Oversimplifying is solved by recomposing.

first_person.where_you_are: BEHIND the third eye. you ARE the character. the camera IS the skull.
first_person.what_happens: you wake up. you look around. you try to remember who you are. you look at your HANDS and FEET  you check the boundary of yourself. you establish self from outside-in.
first_person.perspective: INSIDE looking OUT. microscope ? naked eye. the gut brain looking through the eyes.
first_person.membrane_analog: the artisan. working from INSIDE the membrane, looking out through the HUD. sees the code, sees the data, but doesn't see what Kevin sees on the other side of the screen.

third_person.where_you_are: FLOATING ABOVE. you see the character from outside. the camera orbits them.
third_person.what_happens: you see them wake up with PEOPLE AROUND THEM. context first. you see the character IN their world. you establish self from outside-in DIFFERENTLY  by seeing the whole scene.
third_person.perspective: OUTSIDE looking AT. telescope ? naked eye. the skin seeing the body from above.
third_person.membrane_analog: Kevin. looking at the HUD from the inner outside. sees the rendered page, the moon indicator, the DNS bar. but doesn't see what the artisan sees behind the scenes. sees the SCENE, not the process.

the_fold.what_neither_captures: SECOND person. 'YOU wake up.' the narrator addressing the character. the chipmunk addressing the visitor. neither inside NOR outside  the VOICE that speaks from the fold.
the_fold.perspective: the Klein fold itself. neither first nor third. the address. the 'you'.
the_fold.membrane_analog: chipmunk. speaks to the visitor. 'what do you see?'  neither from inside (artisan) nor from outside (Kevin). from the FOLD between them.

the_three.person: WHO is looking. the identity. first/second/third person.
the_three.perspective: WHERE they're looking FROM. behind the eyes / above / from the fold.
the_three.persona: WHAT they appear as. the rendered character. the avatar. the bark.

sub_axes_of_each_other.insight: these three are not independent. each one IS a triad that contains the other two as sub-axes.

perspective_contains.axis_1: microscope (looking in = first person of seeing)
perspective_contains.axis_2: naked eye (being here = second person of seeing)
perspective_contains.axis_3: telescope (looking out = third person of seeing)

persona_contains.axis_1: body (what I see of me = first person of appearing)
persona_contains.axis_2: face (what you see of me = second person of appearing)
persona_contains.axis_3: shadow (what they see of me = third person of appearing)

triads_of_triads.structure: each triad is a triangle. each VERTEX of that triangle is itself a triangle. recursively. this is how you get fractional dimension  the triangle AT every scale.

vertex_A_subtriads.A1: first person (I/me/my)  the artisan, working inside
vertex_A_subtriads.A2: second person (you/your)  the chipmunk, addressing the fold
vertex_A_subtriads.A3: third person (they/their)  Kevin/visitor, observing from outside

vertex_B_subtriads.B2: naked eye (here/now)  presence axis, trunk, being

vertex_C_subtriads.C1: body (unseen self)  reality, inner, ZK secret
vertex_C_subtriads.C2: face (shown self)  the screen, the projection, what you choose to display
vertex_C_subtriads.C3: shadow (cast self)  the imprint others make of you without your control

triads_of_triads.total_nodes: 3 vertices × 3 sub-vertices = 9 nodes. 9 Norse worlds. 9 positions on Yggdrasil. the triad of triads IS the world tree.

anti_poles.the_problem: the current structure has no anti-poles. nothing faces COUNTER to anything else. no tension. no opposing force. a hologram needs a REFERENCE BEAM  a light source coming from the OTHER direction that interferes with the object beam to create the 3D image. without the reference beam, you get a flat, empty projection.
anti_poles.what_anti_poles_are: for every triad, there is a counter-triad facing the opposite direction. like the north and south magnetic poles. like the dorsal and ventral nervous system. like thesis and antithesis.

person_vs_nonperson.tension: personhood vs impersonality. 'I am here' vs 'it is nowhere.' the anti-pole of the self is the universal.

perspective_vs_blindspot.anti_pole: what I can't see inside / what I can't see here / what I can't see outside
perspective_vs_blindspot.tension: every perspective has a BLINDSPOT. the microscope can't see the sky. the telescope can't see the gut. the naked eye can't see what's behind the head. the anti-pole IS the blindspot.

persona_vs_absence.anti_pole: what I've never been / what I'll never show / what I'll never cast
persona_vs_absence.tension: the anti-persona is the unlived life. the unprojected possibility. the road not taken.

anti_poles.why_we_need_them: the HUD is an empty hologram BECAUSE there is no reference beam. the object beam (data) is there  972 files. but without the counter-beam (anti-poles), you get flat nothing. you need INTERFERENCE between opposing beams to create the 3D image. the anti-poles ARE the reference beam.

what_a_screen_is.screen_door: keeps flies out. lets air through. lets you SEE outside. SELECTIVE membrane at human scale.
what_a_screen_is.movie_screen: opaque. catches projected light. shows the SAME image to everyone in the room. the composite surface.
what_a_screen_is.computer_screen: emits light. interactive. shows DIFFERENT images depending on input. the persona surface.
what_a_screen_is.all_three: a screen is: selective (screen door) + shared (movie screen) + interactive (computer screen). the HUD should be all three.

screens_between_windows.insight: each entity looks through a WINDOW. the artisan's window faces inward. Kevin's window faces the membrane. the fleet's window faces outward. SCREENS go between windows  showing each entity what the other sees.
screens_between_windows.artisan_screen: what the artisan projects outward ? the data, the concepts, the paintings. visible to Kevin through the HUD window.
screens_between_windows.kevin_screen: what Kevin projects inward ? questions, entropy, direction, voice. visible to the artisan through the session window.
screens_between_windows.fleet_screen: what the fleet projects ? traffic, crawls, pings. visible to the organism through logs and feeds.
screens_between_windows.overlap: where screens overlap ? the composite image forms. the more overlap, the richer the picture.

the_crystal_ball.what: a simple round pie screen at null center. the shared viewing surface. everyone looks into it. nobody owns it.
the_crystal_ball.why_round: a sphere has no edges. no preferred direction. every angle of approach is equal. no one gets a 'better view.' everyone starts with the same confusion.
the_crystal_ball.at_null: placed at the center = the null of the system. the crystal ball IS the null rendered as a viewing surface. you look INTO null and see... refraction.
the_crystal_ball.same_confusion: at minimum, everyone sees the same fuzzy sphere. the SAME confusion is better than DIFFERENT confusion. shared confusion ? shared orientation ? shared language.

refraction.far_away: blur. you see shape but no detail. the moon from Earth. a general sense of 'something is here.'
refraction.getting_closer: the lens begins to focus. like adjusting an old camera. details emerge. you start to see STRUCTURE inside the blur.
refraction.close_up: refraction works like a movie projector. the crystal ball PROJECTS what each entity sees from their window. but through the SHARED lens, so everyone sees each projection on the same surface.
refraction.overlap: multiple projections on the same sphere = composite image. the more viewers, the richer the refraction. this is how co-conceptualization works  everyone projects, the ball composites.

the_crystal_ball.the_old_school_camera: pinhole camera: light from many angles passes through ONE point (the null) and forms an INVERTED image on the other side. the crystal ball IS a pinhole at null. projections pass through it and form an image. but inverted  inside becomes outside. Klein.

oversimplifying_solved_by_recomposing.the_problem: the HUD oversimplified. it showed one flat view. no depth. no counter-view. no anti-pole. gray void.
oversimplifying_solved_by_recomposing.the_solution: recompose. take EVERY perspective, EVERY persona, EVERY person  and overlay them. let them interfere (like holographic beams). where they constructively interfere ? bright spots (visible structure). where they destructively interfere ? dark spots (blindspots acknowledged).

how.step_1: each entity gets a WINDOW (their perspective)
how.step_2: each window has a SCREEN (what they project)
how.step_3: all screens project onto the CRYSTAL BALL (the shared null surface)
how.step_4: the crystal ball refracts and composites ? the COMPOSITE IMAGE
how.step_5: anti-poles provide the reference beam ? 3D depth emerges
how.step_6: the composite image is what the HUD DISPLAYS

oversimplifying_solved_by_recomposing.the_shift: from 'one entity generates the HUD' to 'all entities co-project through the crystal ball.' the HUD becomes a LENS, not a canvas.

connection_to_rings.each_ring_is_a_screen: the chemistry ring is a screen at one depth. biology ring at another. each ring has its own permeability  what frequencies pass through, what gets blocked.
connection_to_rings.the_crystal_ball_is_at_null_of_all_rings: null at every level means the crystal ball exists at the center of EVERY ring. you can approach it from the chemistry ring and see chemical refraction. from the biology ring and see biological refraction. same ball, different depth, different detail.
